name: Dialogen by TURBOHOST
author: TURBOHOST

sections.description:
Dialogen by TURBOHOST adds a lightweight floating chat widget to your WordPress site. It lets site owners display quick FAQ-style answers and a WhatsApp call-to-action without requiring an AI account.

Main features:

  • Enable or disable the public chat widget.
  • Choose where the widget appears: the whole site, only the homepage, or all pages except up to three excluded pages.
  • Configure the WhatsApp number, message, and button label.
  • Add up to six quick FAQ buttons with custom responses.
  • Customize the widget title, chat status text, welcome text, position, and primary color.
  • Manage the widget from a dedicated WordPress admin screen.

This plugin is designed for simple customer contact flows, basic support questions, and quick redirection to WhatsApp.

External Services

This plugin connects to the Dialogen by TURBOHOST service to load the public chat widget script and display the chat interface on the site.

Service used: Dialogen by TURBOHOST
Service URL: https://dialogen.turbohost.cl/embed.js
Data sent: an anonymous site identifier (clientId), widget configuration such as title, buttons, labels, colors, and usage events required to operate the chat widget.
Privacy policy: https://panel.turbohost.cl/index.php/knowledgebase/38/Politicas-de-privacidad.html
Terms of service: https://panel.turbohost.cl/index.php/knowledgebase/35/Terminos-de-servicio.html
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/dialogen-by-turbohost directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to the Dialogen menu in the WordPress admin area.
  4. Configure your WhatsApp number, button labels, responses, and widget settings.
  5. Save your changes.
sections.faq:
Do I need an account to use this plugin?

No. The basic widget settings can be configured from WordPress.

Does this plugin use an external service?

Yes. The public widget script is loaded from the Dialogen by TURBOHOST service. See the External Services section for details.

Can I disable the public widget?

Yes. You can disable the widget from the plugin settings.
